beats.text: Five subtle things that quietly make people respect you.
One. Being on time — every time. It tells people you value their life as much as your own.
Two. Doing exactly what you said you'd do. Reliability is rarer, and louder, than charm.
Three. Staying calm while everyone else loses their head. Steadiness reads as strength.
Four. Saying 'I don't know' without flinching. Only secure people admit the gaps.
Five. Treating the junior and the senior with exactly the same courtesy.
Respect isn't demanded or performed. It's the quiet residue of how you consistently behave.
